title: REFERENCE Richards convergence-cliff linear-solver harness diagnosis

decisive_harness_fact.behavior: The test stub sets every element of the returned Newton correction vector to exactly zero and returns ierror=0.
decisive_harness_fact.consequence: For the F-SI18 and F-PE03 perturbation probes, Newton iterations cannot change pressure head through the tridiagonal solve. An initial residual below the configured convergence threshold can pass immediately; an initial residual above that threshold cannot be reduced by Newton and therefore deterministically exhausts MaxIt and backtracking.

fpe03_confirmation.interpretation: The previously reported 3e-12 to 1e-11 cost cliff is a valid characterization of the current isolated harness contract, but it is not evidence of a production Richards nonlinear convergence cliff.

canonical_swap431_crosscheck.real_tridag_behavior: Performs tridiagonal decomposition, forward substitution and back substitution; returns nonzero solution corrections when the linear system requires them, or ierror on near-singular pivots.

owner_implication.next_required_capability: A solver-tail qualification harness must link a numerically functional tridiagonal solver equivalent to the qualified/reference implementation, while retaining the existing explicit F-SI state, provider, solver-control and transaction boundaries.
owner_implication.likely_owner: F-TA/F-VQ test and qualification architecture, with F-SI supplying the solver contract and source locks
